title: New York's 10th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: New York's 10th Congressional District, encompassing parts of Lower Manhattan and Brooklyn, holds a competitive Democratic primary for the 2026 general election. Incumbent Rep. Daniel Goldman (D) faces a strong challenge from former New York City Comptroller Brad Lander in the June 23 Democratic primary, with Goldman backed by party leaders Gov. Kathy Hochul and Rep. Hakeem Jeffries while Lander is endorsed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Sen. Bernie Sanders. The Republican nominee is Jennifer Moore, who advanced without appearing on the primary ballot. The seat is rated Safe/Solid Democratic by major election forecasters, making the Democratic primary the de facto decisive contest.
polling_note: Polls shown are for the Democratic primary, which is the decisive contest in this safely Democratic district. Two polls from 2025-2026 show Brad Lander leading incumbent Dan Goldman among likely Democratic primary voters.

candidates.name: Daniel Goldman
candidates.summary: Daniel Goldman is the incumbent U.S. Representative for New York's 10th Congressional District, first elected in 2022. A former federal prosecutor who served as lead counsel for House Democrats during the first impeachment of President Donald Trump, Goldman is running for re-election on his record of supporting Medicare for All, the Green New Deal, and legislation on social security, organized labor, paid family leave, and affordable housing. He is endorsed by Gov. Kathy Hochul and House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries.

candidates.name: Brad Lander
candidates.summary: Brad Lander is a former New York City Comptroller (2022-2025) and former New York City Councilmember representing the 39th District (2010-2021). He ran for Mayor of New York City in 2025, placing third in the Democratic primary. Lander is running for Congress on a progressive platform emphasizing fighting authoritarianism, making New York affordable, taxing billionaires, and getting money out of politics. He is endorsed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani and U.S. Sen. Bernie Sanders.

candidates.name: Jennifer Moore
candidates.summary: Jennifer Moore is the Republican and Conservative Party nominee for New York's 10th Congressional District in the 2026 general election. She advanced from the Republican primary without appearing on the ballot. Moore is running in a district that strongly favors Democrats, with the incumbent winning 81.0% of the vote in 2024, making this a long-shot bid for the Republican Party.
